title: List environments
summary: List reusable environment templates for session runtime setup.

title: Create environment
summary: Create a reusable environment template for session containers, package policy, sandboxing, and network access.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Human-readable environment name.

parameters.name: hosting_type
parameters.description: Where session work runs. The published config.type spelling of the same field is also read, and sending both with different values is refused. An update that names one spelling replaces the stored spelling in the other, so an environment stored with the published spelling can be repaired from this form. cloud means the platform decides: sessions provision on the workspace's configured default backend, which the response reports as effective_sandbox_provider.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Published CMA configuration. config.type is read as hosting_type (config.type: "cloud" runs sessions on the workspace's configured default backend), config.networking is normalized into the recorded local network key names, and config.packages is preserved without being installed.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Limited or unrestricted network policy. A limited policy is applied per backend: enforced on docker (internal network plus allowlist egress proxy), best-effort on local (proxy environment variables), unsupported on kubernetes and self_hosted; web_fetch and MCP url connects enforce it on every backend. The response reports the strength as networking_enforcement.

parameters.name: packages
parameters.description: Package manager and package declarations available in this environment. Recorded, not installed: no provider here installs them.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: Optional sandbox override for sessions using this environment.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Opaque environment tags.

title: Update environment
summary: Update an environment template with patch semantics: omitted fields are preserved, a metadata value of null or empty string deletes that key, and description: null clears the description. PUT remains accepted as a deprecated alias.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Human-readable environment name.

parameters.name: hosting_type
parameters.description: Hosting mode. The published config.type spelling of the same field is also read, and sending both with different values is refused. An update that names one spelling replaces the stored spelling in the other, so an environment stored with the published spelling can be repaired from this form. cloud means the platform decides: sessions provision on the workspace's configured default backend.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Published CMA configuration. config.type is read as hosting_type (config.type: "cloud" runs sessions on the workspace's configured default backend), config.networking is normalized into the recorded local network key names, and config.packages is preserved without being installed.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Network policy: a limited policy is enforced on docker, best-effort on local, unsupported on kubernetes and self_hosted; see networking_enforcement on the response.

parameters.name: packages
parameters.description: Package declarations. Recorded, not installed: no provider here installs them.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: Sandbox override.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Merged key-by-key into the stored tags; a null or empty-string value deletes its key.

title: Delete environment
summary: Permanently delete an environment. Refused with environment_protected for the workspace default and with environment_in_use while any session — running or finished — references it.

title: Archive environment
summary: Archive an environment so it cannot be selected for new sessions.
